rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for something associated with the countryside.

example.english: When I was little, I often stayed in a rural area with my grandma for a few days.
example.traditional: 我細個成日跟阿婆去鄉下地方住幾日。
example.jyutping: ngo5 sai3 go3 seng4 jat6 gan1 aa3 po4 heoi3 hoeng1 haa2 dei6 fong1 zyu6 gei2 jat6

rows.note: Use this for a more official or geographical description of rural areas, especially in compounds such as 鄉郊地區.

example.english: The government plans to improve public transport in rural areas.
example.traditional: 政府計劃改善鄉郊地區嘅公共交通。
example.jyutping: zing3 fu2 gai3 waak6 goi2 sin6 hoeng1 gaau1 dei6 keoi1 ge3 gung1 gung6 gaau1 tung1

rows.note: Use this when the rural setting specifically involves villages or agricultural communities.

example.english: People in this rural village used to make a living from farming.
example.traditional: 呢條農村以前人人都靠種田為生。
example.jyutping: ni1 tiu4 nung4 cyun1 ji5 cin4 jan4 jan4 dou1 kaau3 zung3 tin4 wai4 saang1
